resources.string:
1. Plug in your charger.
2. Tap ACTIVATE to enable protection.
3. If the charger is unplugged by anyone, an emergency siren will blast!
4. (Anti-Headset): The alarm will force sound through the main speaker even if a headset is plugged in.
5. To stop the alarm, simply Unlock your phone or tap STOP ALARM.

✔️ Supports Android 7.0 up to Android 16+
